evidence_note: Cases catalog the books claims in own words; speculative identifications and OCR noise keep each case gaps visible.

cases.name: Federation assembly
cases.pattern: Lodges federate through assembly and short-mandate election, producing unity by meeting rather than command.

cases.name: Confessional-political enabling
cases.pattern: Political and confessional conditions enable the federation to form and spread; legitimacy follows elite recruitment and respectability reform.

cases.name: Founding-date dispute
cases.pattern: Minutes challenge the inherited founding date, showing archive evidence correcting origin legend.

cases.name: Institutional capture
cases.pattern: An empire absorbs a movement by adopting its symbols and offices, turning opposition into administration.

cases.name: Suppressed lineage
cases.pattern: A lineage survives suppression by custodial transmission through hidden carriers.

cases.name: Brazilian Masonry after 1964
cases.pattern: Decline is attributed to division, exposure, and spying rather than doctrine, a case of fruit-test reading.

cases.name: Pythagorean school
cases.pattern: The school case shows triangle equality and staged disclosure operating as formation discipline.

cases.name: Hiram
cases.pattern: The builder legend is read through the number system as disharmony resolved by a commander figure.

cases.name: The hoax case
cases.pattern: An invented Luciferian order with a female witness gains papal approval, then collapses under confession and audit.

cases.name: The archbishop witness
cases.pattern: A high-degree witness account is dismantled by numerology checks and credibility audit.

cases.name: The doctor-infiltrator
cases.pattern: Purchased degrees and escalating evocations are audited as a fabricated infiltration narrative.

cases.name: The converted adept
cases.pattern: Lineage-legend authority, schism, and publishing are traced as the real engines of a conversion testimony.

cases.name: The strongest witness
cases.pattern: The best witness for the alleged order fails identifiability and document checks, collapsing dependent claims.

cases.name: Watchers and Nephilim
cases.pattern: The descent distributes magical arts to humanity and frames the fall as incarnation rather than failure.

cases.name: Yazidi peacock standard
cases.pattern: Peacock standard, sacred wells, and counterclockwise circumambulation carry an angelic cult pattern across cultures.

cases.name: Seth Osiris Horus
cases.pattern: Envy, coffin trap, dismemberment, and recovery model older gods becoming demons under a newer order.

cases.name: Bavarian Illuminati
cases.pattern: A secret order with eye seal and graded illumination survives suppression inside conspiracy memory.

cases.name: Hiram Abiff
cases.pattern: The master refuses the secret three times, is buried under acacia, found, and raised.

cases.name: Rosicrucian brethren
cases.pattern: A hidden society bound by six rules leaves a secret tomb discovered generations later.

cases.name: Sheba and Solomon
cases.pattern: Riddle-testing exchanges wealth for wisdom and links lineage, ark, and emerald.

cases.name: Delphi oracle
cases.pattern: Purification, vapor induction, scribal recording, interpretation, and poetic publication are separated into roles.

cases.name: Trophonius cave
cases.pattern: Cave descent, honey-cake offering, memory waters, written testimony, and priestly interpretation form the case.

cases.name: Hiram
cases.pattern: Three attackers kill the master for withholding the word; acacia marks the burial and searchers raise the body.

cases.name: Phoenix cycle
cases.pattern: The long-lived bird dies, renews, and priests verify the cycle against date records.

cases.name: Apis bull
cases.pattern: A marked animal is consecrated, processed, mourned, and replaced by a newly recognized bull.

cases.name: Faust pact
cases.pattern: An unprotected invocation forces a pact after spirits are tested by speed before one is accepted.

cases.name: Eleusinian lesser and greater
cases.pattern: A nine-day sequence of lesser and greater rites frames descent and return as staged admission.

cases.name: Pyramid initiation
cases.pattern: Chambers, passages, and a riddle pattern structure a symbolic second birth inside the monument.

cases.name: Isis and Osiris reassembly
cases.pattern: Scattering, search, and reassembly restore the body with the missing part substituted and marked.

cases.name: Bembine Table
cases.pattern: Triads, a central throne figure, and upper governors organize a layered reading with competing interpretations kept open.

cases.name: Vault discovery
cases.pattern: A seven-sided founder vault with altar, plates, and books is discovered after 120 years; the slice marks it as lacking historical corroboration.

cases.name: Flamel book and master
cases.pattern: Images stay opaque until a teacher explains part of them, after which the work is completed with his wife.

cases.name: Paracelsus reform
cases.pattern: Reform by observation, experience, and vernacular teaching against inherited dogma.

cases.name: Alchemical wedding
cases.pattern: A seven-day narrative ends in homunculi, knighthood, and five articles, read as graded transformation.

cases.name: Essene community
cases.pattern: Three degrees, a probation year, crafts, agriculture, healing, and guarded doctrine structure the community.

cases.name: Xibalba trials
cases.pattern: Twin heroes pass seven trials, die, return as fish and magicians, and kill the death lords.

cases.name: Midewiwin records
cases.pattern: Four degrees, medicine-bag initiation, birch-bark records, and healing instruction carry the system.

cases.name: Magdalene exile
cases.pattern: Royal priestess and heir-bearer reading, exile to France, Sara tradition, and persecution memory preserve the lineage.

cases.name: Templar excavation
cases.pattern: A public protective mission is presented as cover for temple excavation, banking wealth, and recovered deposits.

cases.name: Memphis-Mizraim charter
cases.pattern: An Egyptianizing rite passes by charter and recombines into a modern occult order.

gaps: Many historical identifications are speculative and depend on secondary occult literature rather than primary evidence.
Similar names, symbols, and myths are often treated as transmission without sufficient proof.
OCR noise garbles names, dates, and foreign terms in several books.
Most material is symbolic or historical; procedures, durations, and safeguards are largely absent.
Printed page numbers differ from PDF page markers; markers are the reliable locator.
